changes.before:
Reception: arrival circulation naturally reaches the visitor service face of a counter integrated with the architectural interface; a usable staff work face and staff access sit behind it.
Reception: reception service and a generous grouped waiting area spread laterally across the open main hall, joined by clear visitor circulation rather than a single longitudinal passage.
Reception: waiting seats and small tables face one another for real waiting and conversation, with room to pass around them; some seats stand free of the art edge while remaining visually connected to it.
Reception: the visible background semi-open transition progresses through recessed and staggered interfaces to a screened onward access boundary with staff circulation clear of the seated guest area.
changes.after:
Reception: arrival circulation naturally reaches the visitor service face of a counter integrated with the architectural interface; a usable staff work face and staff access sit behind it, supporting check-in and appointment service while the visitor approach stays clear.
Reception: reception service and a generous grouped waiting area spread laterally across the open main hall, joined by clear visitor circulation rather than a single longitudinal passage.
Reception: waiting seats and small tables face one another for real waiting and conversation, with room to pass around them; some seats stand free of the art edge while remaining visually connected to it, supporting a quiet stay and brief review of service information before the onward handoff.
Reception: the visible background semi-open transition progresses through recessed and staggered interfaces to a screened onward access boundary with staff circulation clear of the seated guest area; this is a staff-guided service threshold, easy to locate from reception rather than an empty background passage.

changes.before:
Reception service counter integrated with the architectural interface, with a visitor service face connected to arrival circulation and a distinct usable staff work face behind it
Waiting area with at least one generous group of seats and small tables facing one another beside the integrated translucent partition, partly free-standing with clear circulation around the group
Open lateral reception and waiting circulation with readable building surfaces and a visible background semi-open transition
Reception recessed and staggered screened access boundary with discreet onward service entrances without showing room interiors
Reception integrated translucent sheet interface with large curved sections, spaced transition layers and fine thin edges revealing space behind it
changes.after:
Reception service counter integrated with the architectural interface, with distinct visitor and staff faces, one discreet tablet and one small unlettered desk card; the service surface remains mostly clear
Waiting area with a generous sofa and armchair group facing small tables beside the integrated translucent partition, partly free-standing with clear circulation; one closed unlettered service booklet and a small water tray make the stay readable
Open lateral reception and waiting circulation with readable building surfaces and a visible background semi-open transition
Reception recessed and staggered screened access boundary with discreet onward service entrances, one small blank direction plaque and an ordered secondary interface, without showing room interiors
Reception integrated translucent sheet interface with large curved sections, spaced transition layers and fine thin edges revealing space behind it
Reception architectural wall panel reserved as a quiet unlettered identity surface near the counter; these sparse service details remain secondary to the building and the pearlescent art
